metadata.title: Proof of the Penrose Conjecture for Maximally Parameterized Initial Data Sets
metadata.abstract: We prove the spacetime Penrose inequality for asymptotically flat initial data sets $(M^n,g,k)$ in all dimensions $n\geq 3$, under the dominant energy condition, for data admitting the 'maximally parameterized form' defined in equation (4.7). In this case, the second fundamental form $k$ is locally parameterized by $n(n+1)/2$ functions, giving the same formal local functional degrees of freedom as an arbitrary symmetric $2$-tensor. The proof is based on a new 1-parameter family of generalized Schoen-Yau identities and their gauge-invariant specialization, inspired by the generalized Jang framework of Bray-Khuri [8, 9]. For maximally parameterized data, these identities produce a Riemannian comparison metric \[ \bar g=g+\beta\otimes\beta \] with nonnegative scalar curvature $R_{\bar{g}} \geq 0$. Under a natural nondegeneracy condition (5.7) at the apparent horizon, the comparison metric admits a smooth minimal completion up to $\partial M^n$. Together with suitable asymptotic control, this reduces the Penrose inequality to its Riemannian counterpart. The all-dimensional conclusion uses the Riemannian Penrose theorem of Bi-Zhu [6], together with a minimizing enclosure argument that allows singular boundaries. More generally, in the spirit of [8, 9], we note that the Penrose conjecture follows whenever a certain system of PDEs (3.18) involving $k$ can be solved, in which case our new identity (3.15) immediately implies $R_{\bar{g}} \geq 0$. A natural problem is thus to regularize our degenerate system to prove a general existence theory, thereby proving the Penrose conjecture. Essentially, we believe this is what the OpenAI paper [27] posted last week on October 6, 2026 claims to have done.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 特定初值类的 Penrose 不等式
analysis.workSummary: 作者声称对满足主导能量条件、具有式 (4.7) maximally parameterized form 的渐近平坦初值数据，在全部 n≥3 证明时空 Penrose 不等式；构造推广 Schoen–Yau 恒等式与非负标量曲率比较度量，并在视界非退化性及无穷远控制下归约到黎曼版本。
techniques: 比较度量与极小完备化
analysis.breakthrough: 提出一参数恒等式及特定初值类的归约方案，为一般情形指出待解退化 PDE 系统。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。形式上函数自由度相同不意味着涵盖任意初值；一般 PDE 存在理论仍待建立，且依赖外部全维黎曼 Penrose 定理。摘要提及 OpenAI 前作不能单独证明本篇 AI 协作。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
analysis.aiEvidence: 附录 C 明确说明使用 Claude 协助一般参数 Schoen–Yau 恒等式的代数推导、数值与代数双重核验，并在式 (4.7) 的构造中获得数学建议；还用其起草讨论笔记并探索未纳入本文的一般存在理论。作者强调 t=1 恒等式先由人类推出、正文由作者撰写，且认为 AI 帮助并非决定性；这些限定不抵消已经披露的辅助用途。
